newsitem.title: UK: Allied Domecq sharpens Far East focus.
newsitem.headline: Allied Domecq sharpens Far East focus.

text.p: Drinks and retail group Allied Domecq said it will change its management in the Far East to improve the focus on particular brands in specific markets, making Ballantines and Courvoisier its lead brands.

The changes follow the appointment of Ken Burnett, president Asia Pacific about six months ago. Malcolm Davis will move from his role as regional director Greater China based in Tokyo to vice president Asia Pacific, based in Bristol, southern England.

Davis and his team will be responsible for ensuring that the potential for growth within the region is maximised during the critical period of change in 1997 as Hong Kong reverts to Chinese rule, said the company in a statement.

Jeffrey Lim has been appointed regional director South Asia responsible for the Allied Domecq Spirits and Wine operations in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Phillipines and Indonesia and will be based in Singapore.
The company also appointed Gregg Ainsworth as marketing director Asia Pacific.
